City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 9, 2016 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation by the Solana Center
4B.
Proclamation to the Solana Center
4C.
Proclamation to the San Dieguito Heritage Museum
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the February 10, 2016 Regular Meeting and the February 17, 2016 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2016-03-09 Item 8A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2016-03-09 Item 8B Warrants
8C.
North Regional Zone Master Automatic Aid Agreement for Fire-Rescue Responses and Support Activities. Contact Person: Acting Fire Chief Stein
1) Approve the North Regional Zone Master Automatic Aid Agreement for Fire-Rescue Responses and Support Activities; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to execute the North Regional Zone Master Automatic Aid Agreement for Fire-Rescue Responses and Support Activities.
2016-03-09 Item 8C North Regional Zone Master Automatic Aid Agreement
8D.
Adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2016-02, an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Title of Chapter 2.28 and Various Sections within Chapter 2.28 of the Encinitas Municipal Code, changing "Cabinet Team Positions and Officers" to "Executive Team Positions and Officers" and reflecting the reclassification of Deputy City Manager to the classification of Assistant City Manager. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Ordinance No. 2016-02 titled, "AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF ENCINITAS, CALIFORNIA AMENDING THE TITLE OF CHAPTER 2.28 AND VARIOUS SECTIONS WITHIN CHAPTER 2.28 OF THE ENCINITAS MUNICIPAL CODE."
2016-03-09 Item 8D Adoption of Ordinance 2016-02
8E.
Authorization for the destruction of specific, non-essential, non-permanent records and amendment to the City's Records Retention Schedule. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
1) Adopt Resolution 2016-12 authorizing the destruction of specific, non-essential, non-permanent records in accordance with the City's Records Retention Schedule and Government Code; and 2) Adopt Resolution 2016-13 amending the City's Records Retention Schedule.
2016-03-09 Item 8E Records Destruction & Retention Schedule Amendment
8F.
An amendment to the existing Quartic Solutions contract for additional Information Technology (IT) application support in Fiscal Year 2015-16. Contact Person: Chief Information Officer Tufts
Authorize the City Manager to approve an amendment in the amount of $19,500 to the existing Quartic Solutions contract, for a not-to-exceed total contract amount of $116,240 for Fiscal Year 2015-16.
2016-03-09 Item 8F Quartic Solutions
8G.
Resolution 2016-30, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas in support of becoming a Welcoming Community for immigrants and refugees." Contact Person: Deputy Mayor Shaffer
1) Adopt Resolution 2016-30, titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas in support of becoming a Welcoming Community for immigrants and refugees;" and 2) Direct the Mayor to sign the attached letter to Ron Roberts, Chair of the San Diego County Board of Supervisors, conveying Council Resolution 2016-30.
2016-03-09 Item 8G Welcoming City
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council Initiated Item from Mayor Gaspar regarding American Legion Post 416 Street Section Renaming Project.
2016-03-09 Item 12A Mayor Gaspar Initiated Item
2016-03-09 Item 12A Attachment to Report

ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing to consider adoption of Resolution No. 2016-27 establishing residential permit parking on a portion of Beechtree Drive and Elmbranch Drive. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Blough
***This item has been removed from the agenda by staff and only appears on the agenda because it was publicly noticed.***
10B.
Public Hearing to consider adoption of Resolution 2016-20 establishing residential permit parking on Sea View Court and Pacific View Lane; and no parking between the hours of 10 p.m. and 5 a.m. on Seacrest Way, Sea View Court and Pacific View Lane. Contact Person: Traffic Engineer Blough
***This item has been removed from the agenda by staff and only appears on the agenda because it was publicly noticed.***
10C.
Fiscal Year 2015-16 Mid-Year Budget Status Report and Proposed Budget Amendments. Contact Person: Finance Director Nash
Recommendation Action: Staff recommends that City Council take the following actions: 1) Receive and file the Fiscal Year 2015-16 Mid-Year Budget Status report; and 2) Adopt Resolution 2016-24 titled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2015-16 Budget."
2016-03-09 Item 10C Mid-year Budget Report
10D.
A Resolution of the City of Encinitas City Council to Join California State Association of Counties Excess Insurance Authority (CSAC- EIA), Authorize Execution of the CSAC-EIA Joint Powers Agreement and the Memorandum of Understanding for the Excess General Liability and Property Insurance Programs and Appoint the Risk Department Manager to Act in all Matters Relating to the Member and the Authority. Contact Person: Risk Department Manager Schwarm
Approve Resolution 2016-22 providing consent to join California State Association of Counties Excess Insurance Authority (CSAC EIA), authorize execution of the CSAC-EIA Joint Powers Agreement and the Memorandum of Understanding for Excess General Liability and Property Insurance programs and appoint the Risk Department Manager to act in all matters relating to the member and the Authority.
2016-03-09 Item 10D Risk Agenda Report

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
